entries.title: Isaiah 1:1
segments: ¶The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:2
segments: ¶Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth! For the LORD has spoken: "I have nourished and brought up children, And they have rebelled against Me;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:3
segments: The ox knows its owner And the donkey its master's crib; [But] Israel does not know, My people do not consider."

entries.title: Isaiah 1:4
segments: Alas, sinful nation, A people laden with iniquity, A brood of evildoers, Children who are corrupters! They have forsaken the LORD, They have provoked to anger The Holy One of Israel, They have turned away backward.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:5
segments: Why should you be stricken again? You will revolt more and more. The whole head is sick, And the whole heart faints.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:6
segments: From the sole of the foot even to the head, [There is] no soundness in it, [But] wounds and bruises and putrefying sores; They have not been closed or bound up, Or soothed with ointment.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:7
segments: Your country [is] desolate, Your cities [are] burned with fire; Strangers devour your land in your presence; And [it is] desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:8
segments: So the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, As a hut in a garden of cucumbers, As a besieged city.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:9
segments: Unless the LORD of hosts Had left to us a very small remnant, We would have become like Sodom, We would have been made like Gomorrah.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:10
segments: ¶Hear the word of the LORD, You rulers of Sodom; Give ear to the law of our God, You people of Gomorrah:

entries.title: Isaiah 1:11
segments: "To what purpose [is] the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?" Says the LORD. "I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams And the fat of fed cattle. I do not delight in the blood of bulls, Or of lambs or goats.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:12
segments: "When you come to appear before Me, Who has required this from your hand, To trample My courts?

entries.title: Isaiah 1:13
segments: Bring no more futile sacrifices; Incense is an abomination to Me. The New Moons, the Sabbaths, and the calling of assemblies-I cannot endure iniquity and the sacred meeting.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:14
segments: Your New Moons and your appointed feasts My soul hates; They are a trouble to Me, I am weary of bearing [them].

entries.title: Isaiah 1:15
segments: When you spread out your hands, I will hide My eyes from you; Even though you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:16
segments: ¶"Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean; Put away the evil of your doings from before My eyes. Cease to do evil,

entries.title: Isaiah 1:17
segments: Learn to do good; Seek justice, Rebuke the oppressor; Defend the fatherless, Plead for the widow.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:18
segments: "Come now, and let us reason together," Says the LORD, "Though your sins are like scarlet, They shall be as white as snow; Though they are red like crimson, They shall be as wool.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:19
segments: If you are willing and obedient, You shall eat the good of the land;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:20
segments: But if you refuse and rebel, You shall be devoured by the sword"; For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:21
segments: ¶How the faithful city has become a harlot! It was full of justice; Righteousness lodged in it, But now murderers.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:22
segments: Your silver has become dross, Your wine mixed with water.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:23
segments: Your princes [are] rebellious, And companions of thieves; Everyone loves bribes, And follows after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, Nor does the cause of the widow come before them.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:24
segments: Therefore the Lord says, The LORD of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, "Ah, I will rid Myself of My adversaries, And take vengeance on My enemies.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:25
segments: I will turn My hand against you, And thoroughly purge away your dross, And take away all your alloy.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:26
segments: I will restore your judges as at the first, And your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city."

entries.title: Isaiah 1:27
segments: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, And her penitents with righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:28
segments: The destruction of transgressors and of sinners [shall be] together, And those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:29
segments: For they shall be ashamed of the terebinth trees Which you have desired; And you shall be embarrassed because of the gardens Which you have chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:30
segments: For you shall be as a terebinth whose leaf fades, And as a garden that has no water.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:31
segments: The strong shall be as tinder, And the work of it as a spark; Both will burn together, And no one shall quench [them].
